name: Moroccan Fish, Carrot, Zucchini & Bell Pepper Skillet with Couscous

instructions.primary_message: In a large pot, bring broth to a boil. Remove from heat, add couscous, and stir. Cover and let stand for 10 minutes. Uncover couscous and fluff with a fork.
instructions.secondary_message:
36 fl oz (4 ½ cups) chicken or vegetable broth
3 cups whole wheat couscous

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 red bell peppers
3 medium carrots
3 medium zucchini squash
1 small bunch cilantro
1 lemon

instructions.primary_message: Seed and slice bell peppers into thin strips. Peel, halve, and thinly slice onions. Peel and thinly slice garlic.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium yellow onions
6 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Preheat another large pot over medium-high heat.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add the bell pepper, onion, and garlic; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, about 7 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel and thinly slice carrots. Trim and thinly slice zucchini. Add both to the pot along with the spices. Cook, stirring constantly, until fragrant, about 1 minute.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tsp paprika
1 ½ tsp cumin
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp chili powder
¾ tsp turmeric
½ tsp black pepper
3 pinch crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Stir in the tomatoes, broth, tomato paste, and sugar. Increase temperature to high and bring to a boil; then reduce heat to medium-low and let simmer, stirring occasionally, until vegetables are soft and the sauce has thickened, 6-8 minutes. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ (14.5 oz) cans diced tomatoes
12 fl oz (1 ½ cups) chicken or vegetable broth
6 tbsp tomato paste
1 ½ tsp brown sugar

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Pat the fish dry with paper towels and place on a plate. Season with salt and pepper on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 ¼ lb tilapia fillet
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Sprinkle flour over both sides of each fillet and press gently to adhere.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, add fish to the skillet and cook until opaque and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Remove to a plate and cover with foil.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Add half of the cilantro to the pot and stir to combine (reserve the rest for garnish).
To serve, divide couscous, vegetable sauté, and fish between plates, spooning some of the tomato sauce mixture over the fish. Garnish with cilantro and lemon wedges. Enjoy!
